Phoenix Music, a music player for CC: Tweaked, built on terreng's computercraft-streaming-music.

Install:
wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MADDXSTUDIOS/phoenix-music/main/phoenixmusic.lua phoenixmusic.lua

Highlights
- New look with themes, icons, a visualiser and an About tab
- Favourites, playlists, queue and shuffle
- Speaker Link: play on several computers in sync over wireless/ender modems, with a PIN
- Remote mode: control a player from a pocket computer
- Wired speakers work alongside linked ones
- Show the player on a monitor and the computer at the same time (Settings > Appearance > Monitor)
- Works on computers, pocket computers and monitors
- Built-in updater: checks GitHub and updates itself

Credits: terreng (original player and server), JzJad (Jukebox, inspiration), Phoenix Software.
MIT licensed.
